mapper.sql: id, season_id as seasonId, division_id as divisionId, stage_id as stageId, group_id as groupId, team_id as teamId, event_team_id as eventTeamId, discipline_id as disciplineId, adjustment_type as adjustmentType, adjustment_points as adjustmentPoints, adjustment_reason as adjustmentReason, remark, idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, operator_id as operatorId, operator_name as operatorName, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete
mapper.insert: insert into basket_point_adjustment (season_id, division_id, stage_id, group_id, team_id, event_team_id, discipline_id, adjustment_type, adjustment_points, adjustment_reason, remark, idempotency_key, operator_id, operator_name, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{seasonId}, #{divisionId}, #{stageId}, #{groupId}, #{teamId}, #{eventTeamId}, #{disciplineId}, #{adjustmentType}, #{adjustmentPoints}, #{adjustmentReason}, #{remark}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select from basket_point_adjustment where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select event_team_id as eventTeamId, sum(adjustment_points) as adjustmentPoints from basket_point_adjustment where division_id = #{divisionId} and stage_id = #{stageId} and event_team_id is not null and is_delete = 0 group by event_team_id
